name: data
description: Currency data from data/: ISO 4217 exponents and numeric codes, withdrawn and non-ISO codes with the exponent ISO gave them, CLDR's cash fractions, the currencies of each territory, and crypto units with their base units.

provenance.method: Read from data/ with Python's standard library (json, xml.etree), independently of ducat's generator: ISO 4217 List One and List Three, data/historic.json, CLDR's territories and cash fractions, the crypto units and the cash-rounding rules, each figure kept in its own field.
